assets.name: style-guide
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: art-direction reference sheet for a native children's road-safety game, Crosswalker. Make ONE cohesive physical craft study photographed straight down on a cream tabletop: a small coral-red toy bus, a standing paper-doll child in blue, a little kraft-cardboard house with sage felt roof, a felt tree, a mustard star, and four tiny paper/felt material swatches. This is a construction/style study, not a game screen. STRUCTURE FIRST: bus is a squat rounded rectangular cardboard cutout, two black button wheels, two rectangular pale-blue paper windows, front faces RIGHT; child has one round cardboard head, two simple ink-dot eyes, two arms, two legs, a blue paper tunic; house is a rectangle plus triangle roof; tree is three overlapping irregular felt circles and cardboard trunk; star has exactly five chunky points. DIY hand-cut classroom diorama made by a careful 8-year-old with a parent. Real tactile materials photographed, obvious 2mm corrugated brown cardboard backing edges and fibrous paper, slightly crooked scissor cuts, light glue marks, uneven opaque gouache paint, small pencil construction lines. Restricted palette kraft #CAA574 cream #F5E6C5 sage #637F57 muted coral #BA5845 mustard #D9AC49 dusty blue #5688A1. Soft diffuse daylight from upper left, shallow contact shadows only, everything fully in focus, cozy ordinary handmade craft rather than polished commercial art. Modest, flat layered pieces, no glossy toy render, no plastic, no gradients, no vector-art appearance, no ornate detail, no faces on vehicles, no glitter, no text, no watermark, no extra objects. Each object neatly separated with lots of space so construction is visible. Match the handmade cardboard material spirit of the attached PDF mockup references, not the PDF typography or flat gameplay drawing.

Whole silhouette fits within x=6..94%, y=22..77% of square; rest transparent. Match reference bus exactly in craft style and proportions.

assets.name: home_diorama
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: home-screen illustration for Crosswalker, a cozy handmade classroom road-safety game. ONE physical open cardboard shoe box containing a very simple miniature paper neighborhood: two kraft houses with sage felt triangle roofs, two felt-circle trees, a short charcoal-paper street with ivory paper zebra crossing, one coral cardboard bus with two black button wheels, and one little blue paper-doll child. Reference 1 supplies strict craft material and shape vocabulary. Reference 2 is a PDF page whose small main-menu mockup supplies the open-box idea, not text or a composition to copy. The box has a tall plain back lid and small side flaps, with exposed corrugated cut edges, tiny masking tape patches at corners. The neighborhood sits on green felt inside the box. Photograph from slightly above at a gentle angle, modest shallow handmade diorama, softly lit upper left, not dramatic depth. Plain warm cream tabletop and no other props. Portrait 4:5 image, entire box fills 85% width, all edges in frame. Handmade by a child from paper, glue, cardboard and felt: slight asymmetry, real rough fibers, blunt scissors, visible folds. Palette kraft #CAA574 cream #F5E6C5 sage #637F57 coral #BA5845 blue #5688A1 mustard #D9AC49. Very restrained composition. NO text, NO letters, NO logo, NO interface, NO printed symbols on box, NO plastic, NO CGI polish, NO painted detailed landscape, no ornate details. This is decorative artwork only; game controls will be added separately.
